name: Tube Screamer TS9
description: The iconic overdrive that's shaped countless recordings.
detailedDescription: The Ibanez Tube Screamer TS9 remains one of the most influential overdrive pedals ever created. Known for its distinctive mid-hump and smooth clipping, it excels at pushing tube amps into natural breakup while tightening low end. Perfect for blues, classic rock, or as a boost for solos, its transparent character enhances your guitar's natural voice.

name: Carbon Copy Deluxe
description: Rich analog delay with expanded features.
detailedDescription: The MXR Carbon Copy Deluxe builds on the success of the original with added functionality. Its all-analog bucket brigade circuit delivers warm, musical repeats up to 600ms, while the tap tempo and modulation controls allow for precise time-based effects. The addition of bright mode and expression pedal input expands its versatility for any genre.

name: Big Muff Pi
detailedDescription: The Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi has defined the sound of fuzz since the '70s. Its distinctive thick, creamy distortion with near-endless sustain has been featured on countless recordings across all genres. From David Gilmour's searing leads to Jack White's aggressive riffs, the Big Muff provides a wall of sound that cuts through any mix.

name: POG2
description: Advanced polyphonic octave generator with extensive control.
detailedDescription: The Electro-Harmonix POG2 transforms your guitar into a full ensemble with its polyphonic octave generation. Track multiple octaves simultaneously without glitches or artifacts, even with complex chords. The attack and LP filter sliders allow detailed sound sculpting, while presets enable instant access to your favorite settings. From subtle organ-like textures to dramatic synth effects, it's a creative powerhouse.

name: Afterneath V3
detailedDescription: The EarthQuaker Devices Afterneath V3 creates ethereal soundscapes unlike any conventional reverb. Blending reverb and delay algorithms with multiple cascading delays, it generates everything from subtle cave-like ambience to infinite, swelling drones. The drag control allows for pitch-bending effects, while the V3's added expression pedal support and flexible modes expand its creative potential for ambient explorations.

name: Plumes
description: Versatile, modern overdrive with three distinct clipping modes.
detailedDescription: The EarthQuaker Devices Plumes modernizes the classic tube screamer circuit with higher headroom, lower noise floor, and three distinctive clipping modes. Mode 1 offers transparent, clean boost; Mode 2 provides the classic symmetrical clipping; and Mode 3 delivers asymmetrical, OpAmp distortion. With its remarkable clarity and versatility, the Plumes has become an instant classic for players of all genres.

name: H9 Max
description: Professional multi-effects with algorithms from Eventide's legendary hardware.
detailedDescription: The Eventide H9 Max brings studio-quality effects to a compact pedal format. With over 50 algorithms derived from the company's legendary rack processors, it covers everything from pitch shifting and modulation to delays and otherworldly reverbs. Bluetooth connectivity allows intuitive control via the H9 app, while the extensive MIDI implementation makes it perfect for complex professional setups.

name: El Capistan
description: Premium tape echo emulation with exceptional realism.
detailedDescription: The Strymon El Capistan meticulously recreates the nuances of classic tape echo machines in a compact format. Its DSP engine captures the warm saturation, subtle wow and flutter, and natural tape degradation that made the originals so musical. With three tape head configurations and multiple modes, it spans everything from rockabilly slap-back to ambient multi-head washes, all with remarkable audio fidelity.

name: Tumnus Deluxe
description: Enhanced Klon-inspired overdrive with expanded EQ.
detailedDescription: The Wampler Tumnus Deluxe takes the transparent overdrive of the original Tumnus (inspired by the legendary Klon Centaur) and adds a 3-band EQ for enhanced tonal control. From subtle boost to rich overdrive, it preserves your guitar's fundamental character while adding harmonic complexity. The hot/normal switch allows toggling between standard gain and higher output for solos or driving high-headroom amps.

name: CE-2W Chorus
description: Authentic reissue of the classic chorus pedal with modern enhancements.
detailedDescription: The Boss CE-2W Waza Craft chorus faithfully recreates the lush, warm analog chorus sounds that defined the '80s. Beyond the original CE-2 mode, it also includes the CE-1 chorus and vibrato circuits from the legendary 1970s pedal. With all-analog circuitry, bucket-brigade technology, and expanded stereo capabilities, it delivers the definitive vintage chorus experience with modern reliability.

name: Polytune 3 Mini
description: Compact, precise polyphonic tuner with buffer option.
detailedDescription: The TC Electronic Polytune 3 Mini packs innovative tuning technology into a micro-sized format. Its polyphonic mode allows you to strum all strings at once for instant feedback, while the strobe mode offers accuracy within 0.02 cents. The switchable buffer helps maintain signal integrity in large pedalboards, and the bright LED display remains visible even on outdoor stages. An essential utility pedal that won't consume precious board space.

name: Phase 90
description: Iconic phaser with unmistakable sweep and swirl.
detailedDescription: The MXR Phase 90 has been defining the sound of phase shifting since the 1970s. Its warm, organic sweep has adorned countless recordings, from Eddie Van Halen's guitar work to Radiohead's keyboards. With a single speed control, it offers plug-and-play simplicity while delivering everything from slow, subtle movement to rapid, burbling swirls. The distinct orange box remains a pedalboard staple for players of all genres.

name: Dispatch Master V3
description: Versatile reverb and delay combination for atmospheric textures.
detailedDescription: The EarthQuaker Devices Dispatch Master V3 combines high-quality digital delay and reverb in one intuitive pedal. From subtle ambience to cavernous washes, its organic sound enhances your playing without overwhelming it. The updated V3 version adds flexi-switching for momentary operation and tails mode for natural effect decay when bypassed. Perfect for players seeking spacious textures without the complexity of multi-effect units.

name: Plexi-Drive Deluxe
description: Marshall Plexi-inspired overdrive with expanded EQ options.
detailedDescription: The Wampler Plexi-Drive Deluxe captures the essence of a cranked Marshall Plexi in a versatile pedal format. Its circuitry replicates the harmonically rich breakup and dynamic response of these legendary amps, while the added bass control and bright switch allow precise tonal tailoring. The boost circuit provides additional gain and volume for solos, making this pedal a complete solution for classic British rock tones.

name: DL4 MkII
description: Legendary delay workstation with modern enhancements.
detailedDescription: The Line 6 DL4 MkII updates the iconic green delay modeler with expanded functionality and improved audio quality. With 15 delay models from the original plus 15 new ones, it covers everything from pristine digital delays to experimental granular effects. The MkII adds MIDI control, enhanced looping capabilities, and an expression pedal input. A modern classic that combines vintage charm with contemporary features.

name: Micro POG
description: Compact polyphonic octave generator for instant tonal expansion.
detailedDescription: The Electro-Harmonix Micro POG delivers polyphonic octave effects in a pedalboard-friendly format. Track complex chords and fast passages without artifacts, adding octaves above and below your original signal. From subtle 12-string emulation to monstrous synth-like textures, its precise tracking and intuitive controls make it a versatile tool for guitarists looking to expand their tonal palette without complex setup or programming.
